title: Paired differences between the three predictors' identity contrasts
why: The NM manuscript's headline is a comparison of THREE point estimates, each with its own
interval, and no interval on any difference between them: RibonanzaNet +0.06055 (CI excludes
zero), ViennaRNA -0.03039 (covers zero), EternaFold -0.00569 (covers zero). From that the
abstract, Claim 2 and the Conclusion all assert 'the split follows the decomposition and not
That is the error this paper retracts TWICE. The depth-baseline kill condition was written as
a comparison of two point estimates with no interval and is recorded as failed for exactly
that reason; the second withdrawbox retracts a two-chemistry comparison for the same fault.
A failure to resolve is not evidence of no effect, and three separate intervals do not license
a statement about the difference between them.
The existing artifacts CANNOT supply the missing interval: m32 computes EternaFold's and
ViennaRNA's contrasts in its own bootstrap and imports RibonanzaNet's point estimate from
m26v, a different run with a different resample. A paired difference needs all four columns
resampled together over the SAME puzzles.

design.records: M26.build() -- 4317 admitted interventions, carrying rf and pmut
design.join: emut from m32_eterna_cache.npz, nmut from m26c_pneural_cache.npz, by exact sequence
design.estimator: M26.matched over (design, min(depth,3), crossed), unchanged, one column at a time
design.bootstrap: ONE resample of the 20 puzzles per draw; all four contrasts recomputed on that
same resample, so every difference is paired. 4000 draws, seed 3501.
design.permutation: within stratum, on the paired difference, 4000 draws

probes_that_must_fire.check: all four columns present on all 4317 records; any join miss VOIDS the run
each single-column contrast recomputed here reproduces its published value to < 1e-4: rf +0.05393, pmut -0.03039, emut -0.00569, nmut +0.06055
the bootstrap resamples 20 puzzles, and the same index vector is used for all four columns within a draw

kill_conditions.then: the sentence 'the split follows the decomposition and not the training data' is NOT licensed and is removed from the abstract, from Claim 2 and from the Conclusion. What replaces it is a bounded statement naming the interval.
Claim 2's separation between the transformer and the thermodynamic model is withdrawn; only the single-arm statements survive.
the run is VOID and no number from it may be reported.
the word 'tracking' is removed wherever the manuscript says the transformer's contrast tracks the measurement, and replaced by the measured difference and its interval.

forbidden: reporting any difference without its interval
reading a covering interval as evidence that two predictors agree
cost: offline, $0. Both prediction caches are on disk; no GPU pass and no API call.
